chat-tabs.config.general.enabled.desc: Show the tab bar and filter chat by tab. Only on Hypixel; other servers always get normal chat.
chat-tabs.config.general.dm_tabs.desc: Open a tab for each player you message or who messages you. Right click a DM tab to close it.
chat-tabs.config.general.max_dm_tabs.des: How many DM tabs can be open; a new conversation closes the oldest.
chat-tabs.config.general.unread.desc: Show how many new messages a tab has, e.g. Guild (3).
chat-tabs.config.general.bar_closed.desc: Keep the tab bar on screen when chat is closed, so you can see unread counts. Tabs are clicked with chat open.
chat-tabs.config.general.bar_position.de: Top: above the chat. Bottom: under the chat. Free: drag the tabs in chat to place them; they snap to the chat's edges and keep their place next to it when the chat moves (e.g. with Huddable).
chat-tabs.config.general.lock_bar.desc: Keep a Free tab bar where it is: clicking a tab only opens it, so the bar can't be dragged by accident. Turn off to move it again.
chat-tabs.config.general.reset_free.desc: Puts a Free tab bar back just above the chat.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.desc: The tabs in the bar, left to right. DM tabs open on their own after these.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.name: Name
chat-tabs.config.tabs.show.dm.desc: Messages from and to players ("From ..." and "To ...").
chat-tabs.config.tabs.show.system.desc: Everything that isn't one of the channels above: NPCs, server and game messages.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.send_to.desc: Where chat typed in this tab goes. Commands you type (starting with /) are sent as they are.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.move_left.desc: Moves this tab one place to the left.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.move_right.desc: Moves this tab one place to the right.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.delete.desc: Removes this tab. The last tab can't be deleted.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.add.desc: Adds a tab showing every message, at the right end.
chat-tabs.config.tabs.reset.desc: Puts back the default tabs: General, All, Guild, Party, DMs and System.
chat-tabs.config.appearance.tab_height.d: Height of the tabs in pixels.
chat-tabs.config.appearance.padding.desc: Space between a tab's border and its name.
chat-tabs.config.appearance.font.desc: Fonts from your resource packs. Unknown fonts fall back to Minecraft's.
Draw tab names with a shadow.
Draw the open tab's name in bold.
chat-tabs.config.appearance.reset.desc: Puts every Appearance setting back to its default.
